title: Bug: TSA/TSB assert in test_ro_disk.py always fails if supervisor is chosen as duthost
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

Currently the test checks for `System Mode: ...` in stdout of TSA/TSB on device, however, if performed on a supervisor duthost, stdout returns `Chassis Mode: ...`.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test on T2 device, until supervisor is chosen randomly by `duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_hostname]` 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

If supervisor returns successful `Chassis Mode: ...`, then the test should continue and not fail.
